sentences.zh: 兵五

translations.literal: Military 5
translations.idiomatic: Military 5

sentences.zh: 土兵

translations.literal: Native Troops
translations.idiomatic: Native Troops

sentences.zh: 土兵惟川、甘、湖廣、雲、貴有之，調征西南，常得其用。

translations.literal: Native troops existed only in Sichuan, Gansu, Huguang, Yunnan, and Guizhou; when mobilized for campaigns in the southwest, they were often found highly useful.
translations.idiomatic: Native troops were found only in Sichuan, Gansu, Huguang, Yunnan, and Guizhou, and when the court mobilized them for southwestern campaigns they proved consistently effective.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，莽依圖戰馬寶於韶嶺，瑤兵為後援。

translations.literal: During the Kangxi reign, Manggitu fought Ma Bao at Shaoling, with Yao troops as rear support.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kangxi era, Manggitu battled Ma Bao at Shaoling with Yao native soldiers in reserve.

sentences.zh: 傅弘烈平廣西，亦藉土兵義勇之力。

translations.literal: When Fu Honglie pacified Guangxi, he likewise relied on the strength of native troops and local volunteers.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Honglie's pacification of Guangxi likewise drew on native troops and local militia.

sentences.zh: 乾隆征廓爾喀，調金川土兵五千，討安南，以土兵隨征。

translations.literal: When the Qianlong Emperor campaigned against Gurkha, he mobilized five thousand Jinchuan native troops; in the campaign against Annam, native troops accompanied the expedition.
translations.idiomatic: For the Gurkha campaign the Qianlong court called up five thousand Jinchuan native soldiers, and native troops marched with the forces sent against Annam.

sentences.zh: 傅恆征金川，疏言：「奮勇摧敵，固仗八旗。

translations.literal: When Fu Heng campaigned in Jinchuan, he memorialized: "Bold assault to break the enemy naturally depends on the Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the Jinchuan campaign Fu Heng wrote: "Smashing the enemy by sheer valor still rests on the Eight Banners.

sentences.zh: 鄉導必用土兵，小金川土兵尤驍勇善戰。

translations.literal: Guides in the field must employ native troops; those of Lesser Jinchuan are especially fierce and skilled in battle.
translations.idiomatic: But guides in the mountains must be native troops, and the soldiers of Lesser Jinchuan are especially fierce and battle-hardened.

sentences.zh: 」岳鍾琪平西藏，咸、同間討黔、蜀髮匪，其明效也。

translations.literal: " Yue Zhongqi's pacification of Tibet, and the suppression of the Taiping rebels in Guizhou and Sichuan during the Xianfeng and Tongzhi reigns, showed the same clear effect.
translations.idiomatic: " The same lesson appeared when Yue Zhongqi pacified Tibet and when, in the Xianfeng and Tongzhi years, native troops helped crush the Taiping bands in Guizhou and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 古西南夷多槃瓠遺種，曰僚、曰伶、曰、曰僮、曰瑤、曰苗。

translations.literal: The ancient southwestern barbarians were largely descendants of Panhu, called Liao, called Ling, called [name missing in text], called Zhuang, called Yao, and called Miao.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient southwestern peoples were largely Panhu descendants known as the Liao, Ling, Zhuang, Yao, Miao, and related groups (one ethnonym is absent in the received text).

sentences.zh: 其後蕃衍，有西番、僰人、擺夷、麼些、佫𬿚、咱哩、裸、俍、瑤等目。

translations.literal: They later multiplied and spread, yielding such categories as Western Tibetans, Bo people, Baiyi, Mosuo, Gelao, Zali, Luo, Liang, Yao, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Over time they proliferated into Western Tibetans, Bo, Baiyi, Mosuo, Gelao, Zali, Luo, Liang, Yao, and many other named groups.

sentences.zh: 苗蠻種類尤多，如花苗、紅苗、花仡佬、紅仡佬、白裸儸、黑裸儸皆是。

translations.literal: Miao and Man tribes were especially numerous, including Flower Miao, Red Miao, Flower Gelao, Red Gelao, White Luoluo, and Black Luoluo.
translations.idiomatic: Miao and related peoples were especially diverse—Flower Miao, Red Miao, Flower and Red Gelao, White and Black Luoluo, and others.

sentences.zh: 土兵多出其中，故驍強可用。

translations.literal: Native troops were drawn largely from among them, and hence were fierce and strong and could be put to use.
translations.idiomatic: Most native troops came from these populations, which is why they were so fierce and dependable in the field.

sentences.zh: 土兵之制，甘肅、四川、兩廣、湖南、雲、貴或隸土司，或屬土弁，或歸營汛。

translations.literal: Under the native-troop system in Gansu, Sichuan, the two Guang provinces, Hunan, Yunnan, and Guizhou, troops might be subordinate to native chieftains, attached to native officers, or assigned to garrison posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Gansu, Sichuan, Guangdong and Guangxi, Hunan, Yunnan, and Guizhou, native troops might answer to tusi chiefs, to native company officers, or to regular garrison commands.

sentences.zh: 甘肅土兵附番部。

translations.literal: Gansu native troops were attached to Fan tribal districts.
translations.idiomatic: In Gansu, native troops were organized through the Fan tribal jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 四川土兵附屯弁、屯蕃。

translations.literal: Sichuan native troops were attached to garrison native officers and garrison Fan communities.
translations.idiomatic: In Sichuan they were tied to garrison native officers and settled Fan communities.

sentences.zh: 湖南土兵附練兵、屯兵。

translations.literal: Hunan native troops were attached to drill troops and garrison militia.
translations.idiomatic: In Hunan they fell under drill regiments and garrison militia.

sentences.zh: 別有番民七十九族，分隸西寧、西藏。

translations.literal: There were in addition seventy-nine Fan tribes, divided between Xining and Tibet jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-nine additional Fan tribes were divided between the Xining and Tibet administrations.

sentences.zh: 茲並述於篇。

translations.literal: All are here described together in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: All of these arrangements are set out below.

sentences.zh: 甘肅土兵：

translations.literal: Gansu native troops:
translations.idiomatic: Gansu native troops:

sentences.zh: 狄道州臨洮衛指揮僉事轄十五族。

translations.literal: At Lintao Guard in Didao Prefecture, the assistant regional commander had jurisdiction over fifteen tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant commander at Lintao Guard in Didao Prefecture oversaw fifteen tribes.

sentences.zh: 河州指揮僉事轄四十八戶。

translations.literal: At Hezhou, the assistant regional commander had jurisdiction over forty-eight households.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhou assistant commander had forty-eight households under him.

sentences.zh: 韓家集指揮使轄二族。

translations.literal: At Hanjiaji, the regional commander had jurisdiction over two tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The commander at Hanjiaji governed two tribes.

sentences.zh: 岷州宕昌城指揮使轄十六族。

translations.literal: At Tanchang City in Minzhou, the regional commander had jurisdiction over sixteen tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The Minzhou commander at Tanchang City ruled sixteen tribes.

sentences.zh: 攢都溝外委百戶轄四十一庄。

translations.literal: The sub-official company commander at Zandugou Outer District had jurisdiction over forty-one villages.
translations.idiomatic: A sub-official centurion at Zandugou Outer District controlled forty-one villages.

sentences.zh: 麻霙里外委土官轄二族。

translations.literal: The sub-official native officer at Mayingli Outer District had jurisdiction over two tribes.
translations.idiomatic: A sub-official native officer at Mayingli Outer District governed two tribes.

sentences.zh: 閭井外委百戶轄十一庄。

translations.literal: The sub-official company commander at Lüjing Outer District had jurisdiction over eleven villages.
translations.idiomatic: A sub-official centurion at Lüjing Outer District had eleven villages.

sentences.zh: 歸安里副千戶轄土民四十八族，番民四十三族。

translations.literal: The deputy chiliarch at Gui'anli had jurisdiction over forty-eight tribes of native commoners and forty-three tribes of Fan people.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy chiliarch at Gui'anli oversaw forty-eight native commoner tribes and forty-three Fan tribes.

sentences.zh: 洮州廳卓泥堡指揮使兼護國禪師轄五百二十族，馬兵五百，步兵千五百，土守備一，千總、把總四，外委七。

translations.literal: At Zhuoni Fort in Taozhou Department, the regional commander who was also State-Protecting Chan Master had jurisdiction over five hundred twenty tribes, with five hundred cavalry, one thousand five hundred infantry, one native garrison commandant, four chiliarchs and platoon leaders, and seven sub-officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Taozhou commander at Zhuoni Fort, who also held the title State-Protecting Chan Master, ruled five hundred twenty tribes with five hundred horse, fifteen hundred foot, one native garrison commandant, four chiliarchs and platoon leaders, and seven sub-officials.

sentences.zh: 資卜指揮使轄七十六族，土守備一，千總、把總、外委各二，馬兵五十，步兵百。

translations.literal: The Zibu regional commander had jurisdiction over seventy-six tribes, with one native garrison commandant, two chiliarchs, two platoon leaders, two sub-officials, fifty cavalry, and one hundred infantry.
translations.idiomatic: The Zibu commander governed seventy-six tribes with one native commandant, two chiliarchs, two platoon leaders, two sub-officials, fifty horse, and one hundred foot.

sentences.zh: 著遜百戶轄七族，兵十人。

translations.literal: The Zhuxun company commander had jurisdiction over seven tribes and ten troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhuxun centurion had seven tribes and ten soldiers.

sentences.zh: 西寧縣寄彥才溝指揮使轄八族，土千總一，把總二，馬兵五十，步兵百。

translations.literal: The regional commander at Yancai Gully in Xining County had jurisdiction over eight tribes, with one native chiliarch, two platoon leaders, fifty cavalry, and one hundred infantry.
translations.idiomatic: The Xining commander at Yancai Gully ruled eight tribes with one native chiliarch, two platoon leaders, fifty horse, and one hundred foot.

sentences.zh: 陳家台指揮使轄一百十二戶，土千總、把總各一，馬兵五，步兵二十。

translations.literal: The Chenjiatai regional commander had jurisdiction over one hundred twelve households, with one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, five cavalry, and twenty infantry.
translations.idiomatic: The Chenjiatai commander had one hundred twelve households, one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, five horse, and twenty foot.

sentences.zh: 乞塔城指揮使轄四十八族，土千總、把總各一，馬步兵各五十。

translations.literal: The Qitacheng regional commander had jurisdiction over forty-eight tribes, with one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, and fifty each of cavalry and infantry.
translations.idiomatic: The Qitacheng commander governed forty-eight tribes with one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, and fifty horse and fifty foot.

sentences.zh: 納家莊指揮僉事轄百二十戶，土千總、把總各一，兵二十五人。

translations.literal: The Najiazhuang assistant regional commander had jurisdiction over one hundred twenty households, with one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, and twenty-five troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Najiazhuang assistant commander had one hundred twenty households, one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, and twenty-five troops.

sentences.zh: 西川海子溝指揮僉事轄番民十八戶，土民三十戶，土千總、把總，兵額同上。

translations.literal: The Xichuan Haizigou assistant regional commander had jurisdiction over eighteen Fan households and thirty native households, with native chiliarch and platoon leader and troop quotas as above.
translations.idiomatic: The Xichuan Haizigou assistant commander had eighteen Fan and thirty native households, with the same native officer and troop quotas as above.

sentences.zh: 迭溝指揮僉事轄九十戶，土千總、把總，兵額同上。

translations.literal: The Diegou assistant regional commander had jurisdiction over ninety households, with native chiliarch and platoon leader and troop quotas as above.
translations.idiomatic: The Diegou assistant commander had ninety households with the same native officer and troop quotas.

sentences.zh: 循化廳土千戶轄西鄉上四工韓姓撒拉。

translations.literal: The native chiliarch in Xunhua Department had jurisdiction over the four upper work-units of the western district, Han-clan Salar.
translations.idiomatic: A native chiliarch in Xunhua oversaw the four upper work-units of the western district, Han-clan Salar.

sentences.zh: 保安堡土千戶轄東鄉下四工馬姓撒拉。

translations.literal: The native chiliarch at Bao'an Fort had jurisdiction over the four lower work-units of the eastern district, Ma-clan Salar.
translations.idiomatic: The Bao'an Fort native chiliarch governed the four lower eastern work-units of the Ma-clan Salar.

sentences.zh: 撒拉不同番回，似羌而奉回教，舊十三工，今隸循化八工，餘隸巴燕戎格。

translations.literal: The Salar differ from Fan and Hui peoples; they resemble Qiang but follow Islam. Formerly there were thirteen work-units; now eight are subordinate to Xunhua and the rest to Bayan Rongge.
translations.idiomatic: The Salar are neither Fan nor ordinary Hui—they resemble the Qiang but practice Islam. Once organized in thirteen work-units, eight now fall under Xunhua and the rest under Bayan Rongge.

sentences.zh: 藏土百戶轄五族。

translations.literal: The Zangtu company commander had jurisdiction over five tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The Zangtu centurion governed five tribes.

sentences.zh: 大通縣大通川土千戶轄五族。

translations.literal: The native chiliarch at Datong River in Datong County had jurisdiction over five tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The native chiliarch on the Datong River in Datong County had five tribes.

sentences.zh: 碾伯縣勝番溝指揮同知轄七百戶，土千總二，把總四，馬步兵百。

translations.literal: The deputy regional commander at Shengfan Gully in Xianbo County had jurisdiction over seven hundred households, with two native chiliarchs, four platoon leaders, and one hundred horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbo deputy commander at Shengfan Gully ruled seven hundred households with two native chiliarchs, four platoon leaders, and one hundred troops.

sentences.zh: 上川口指揮同知轄四千戶，土千戶一，百戶二，土千總四，把總六，馬步兵三百。

translations.literal: The deputy regional commander at Shangchuankou had jurisdiction over four thousand households, with one native chiliarch of the thousand, two company commanders, four native chiliarchs, six platoon leaders, and three hundred horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangchuankou deputy commander had four thousand households, one native thousand-household officer, two centurions, four native chiliarchs, six platoon leaders, and three hundred troops.

sentences.zh: 趙家灣指揮同知轄百二十戶，土千總、把總各一，馬兵五，步兵二。

translations.literal: The deputy regional commander at Zhaojiawan had jurisdiction over one hundred twenty households, with one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, five cavalry, and two infantry.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaojiawan deputy commander had one hundred twenty households, one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, five horse, and two foot.

sentences.zh: 白崖子指揮同知轄百五十戶，兵二十五。

translations.literal: The deputy regional commander at Baiyaizi had jurisdiction over one hundred fifty households and twenty-five troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Baiyaizi deputy commander had one hundred fifty households and twenty-five troops.

sentences.zh: 美都川指揮僉事轄三百戶，土千總、把總各一，兵二十五。

translations.literal: The assistant regional commander at Meiduchuan had jurisdiction over three hundred households, with one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, and twenty-five troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Meiduchuan assistant commander had three hundred households, one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, and twenty-five troops.

sentences.zh: 硃家堡指揮僉事轄六十二戶，兵二十五。

translations.literal: The assistant regional commander at Zhujiabao had jurisdiction over sixty-two households and twenty-five troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhujiabao assistant commander had sixty-two households and twenty-five troops.

sentences.zh: 米拉溝指揮僉事轄七十戶，土千總、把總各一，馬步兵二十五。

translations.literal: The assistant regional commander at Milagou had jurisdiction over seventy households, with one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, and twenty-five horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: The Milagou assistant commander had seventy households, one native chiliarch, one platoon leader, and twenty-five troops.

sentences.zh: 九家巷百戶轄百餘戶，兵二十五。

translations.literal: The Jiujiaxiang company commander had jurisdiction over more than one hundred households and twenty-five troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiujiaxiang centurion had over one hundred households and twenty-five troops.

sentences.zh: 王家堡百戶轄百餘戶，兵二十。

translations.literal: The Wangjiabao company commander had jurisdiction over more than one hundred households and twenty troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Wangjiabao centurion had over one hundred households and twenty troops.

sentences.zh: 喇守庄指揮僉事轄七十二戶。

translations.literal: The assistant regional commander at Lashouzhuang had jurisdiction over seventy-two households.
translations.idiomatic: The Lashouzhuang assistant commander had seventy-two households.

sentences.zh: 庄浪掌印土司指揮使轄指揮僉事、指揮使、指揮同知、正副千戶各一，百戶二，土民十旗，番民八旗，文職隸甘涼道，武職隸西寧鎮。

translations.literal: The Zhuanglang seal-holding tusi regional commander had under him one assistant regional commander, one regional commander, one deputy regional commander, one regular and one deputy chiliarch, two company commanders, ten banners of native commoners and eight banners of Fan people; civil offices were subordinate to the Gansu-Liangzhou circuit and military offices to Xining garrison.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhuanglang tusi who held the official seal commanded one assistant commander, one commander, one deputy commander, regular and deputy chiliarchs, two centurions, ten native and eight Fan banners; civil matters came under the Gansu-Liangzhou circuit and troops under the Xining garrison.

sentences.zh: 紅山堡掌土司印指揮僉事兵五十。

translations.literal: The Hongshan Fort seal-holding assistant regional commander had fifty troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Hongshan Fort tusi seal-holder, an assistant commander, had fifty troops.

sentences.zh: 古城及大營灣指揮使、大通峽口指揮同知、古城正千戶、馬軍堡副千戶、西坪正千戶、西六渠百戶均率親丁效力，不轄土民。

translations.literal: The regional commanders at Gucheng and Dayingwan, the deputy regional commander at Datong Gorge, the regular chiliarch at Gucheng, the deputy chiliarch at Majun Fort, the regular chiliarch at Xiping, and the company commander at Xiliuqu all led their own kinsmen in service and did not govern native commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders at Gucheng, Dayingwan, Datong Gorge, Gucheng chiliarch, Majun Fort deputy chiliarch, Xiping, and Xiliuqu all brought their own clansmen and did not administer native commoner populations.

sentences.zh: 永昌縣流水溝寺千戶轄番民五旗。

translations.literal: The temple chiliarch at Liushuigou in Yongchang County had jurisdiction over five banners of Fan people.
translations.idiomatic: The Liushuigou temple chiliarch in Yongchang County governed five Fan banners.

sentences.zh: 甘肅番部：

translations.literal: Gansu Fan tribal districts:
translations.idiomatic: Gansu Fan tribal districts:

sentences.zh: 狄道州三族，河州十八族，皆康熙時舊族，雜處二十四關內。

translations.literal: Three tribes in Didao Prefecture and eighteen in Hezhou were all old tribes from the Kangxi period, intermixed within the twenty-four passes.
translations.idiomatic: Didao had three tribes and Hezhou eighteen, all Kangxi-era communities scattered through the twenty-four passes.

sentences.zh: 洮州廳八族，大小九十餘處，亦曰南番。

translations.literal: Taozhou Department had eight tribes in more than ninety large and small settlements, also called Southern Fan.
translations.idiomatic: Taozhou had eight tribes spread across ninety-odd settlements, known as the Southern Fan.

sentences.zh: 土司楊積慶屬番民五百二十族。

translations.literal: Tusi Yang Jiqing had five hundred twenty Fan tribes under him.
translations.idiomatic: Tusi Yang Jiqing ruled five hundred twenty Fan tribes.

sentences.zh: 昝天錫屬番民七十六族。

translations.literal: Zan Tianxi had seventy-six Fan tribes under him.
translations.idiomatic: Zan Tianxi had seventy-six Fan tribes.

sentences.zh: 楊永隆屬番民七族。

translations.literal: Yang Yonglong had seven Fan tribes under him.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yonglong had seven Fan tribes.

sentences.zh: 著洛寺僧綱楊溯洛旺秀轄番民二十三族。

translations.literal: The Zhuluo Temple monastic superintendent Yang Suoluowangxiu had jurisdiction over twenty-three Fan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuluo Temple's monastic superintendent Yang Suoluowangxiu governed twenty-three Fan tribes.

sentences.zh: 麻儞寺僧綱馬昂旺丹主轄番民二十一族。

translations.literal: The Mayi Temple monastic superintendent Ma Angwangdanzhu had jurisdiction over twenty-one Fan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Mayi Temple's monastic superintendent Ma Angwangdanzhu had twenty-one Fan tribes.

sentences.zh: 圓成寺僧正侯洛扎旦主轄番民四族。

translations.literal: The Yuancheng Temple monastic prelate Houluozhadanzhu had jurisdiction over four Fan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Yuancheng Temple's prelate Houluozhadanzhu governed four Fan tribes.

sentences.zh: 岷州熟番四十三族，舊屬土司，後為歸安里，惟白水江以南、南山內外，皆黑番所在，亦稱若瓦。

translations.literal: Minzhou had forty-three tribes of acculturated Fan, formerly under tusi, later under Gui'anli; only south of the Baishui River and inside and outside the southern mountains were the Black Fan, also called Ruowa.
translations.idiomatic: Minzhou's forty-three acculturated Fan tribes, once under tusi and later under Gui'anli, contrasted with the Black Fan—also called Ruowa—south of the Baishui River and in the southern mountains.

sentences.zh: 南山以東馬土司轄，以西楊土司轄，凡番寺三十五所，轄番民霙古喇哈等二十四族。

translations.literal: East of the southern mountains was under Ma tusi and west under Yang tusi; in all thirty-five Fan temples governed twenty-four tribes such as Yinggulaha.
translations.idiomatic: Ma tusi ruled east of the southern mountains and Yang tusi to the west; thirty-five Fan temples oversaw twenty-four tribes including Yinggulaha.

sentences.zh: 文縣番族五百族，番地二十二處。

translations.literal: Wen County had five hundred Fan tribes in twenty-two Fan districts.
translations.idiomatic: Wen County had five hundred Fan tribes across twenty-two tribal districts.

sentences.zh: 馬百戶番地二十八處，雍正八年，改番歸流曰新民。

translations.literal: Ma company commander had twenty-eight Fan districts; in the eighth year of Yongzheng, converting Fan to direct administration they were called New Subjects.
translations.idiomatic: The Ma centurion's twenty-eight Fan districts were placed under direct rule in Yongzheng 8 and renamed New Subjects.

sentences.zh: 西寧縣番民十三族，番寺三十八族。

translations.literal: Xining County had thirteen Fan tribes and thirty-eight Fan temple communities.
translations.idiomatic: Xining County had thirteen Fan tribes and thirty-eight temple-affiliated Fan communities.

sentences.zh: 貴德廳熟番舊五十四族，存五族，生番舊十九族，存五族，野番十九族，俱插帳河濱，番寺大者六所。

translations.literal: Guide Department had formerly fifty-four acculturated Fan tribes with five remaining, formerly nineteen raw Fan tribes with five remaining, and nineteen wild Fan tribes, all encamped along the river; there were six major Fan temples.
translations.idiomatic: Guide once had fifty-four acculturated Fan tribes (five left), nineteen raw Fan tribes (five left), and nineteen wild Fan bands along the river, with six major Fan temples.

sentences.zh: 循化廳口內熟番十二族，口外西番四十九寨，口外南番二十一寨。

translations.literal: Xunhua Department had twelve acculturated Fan tribes inside the pass, forty-nine Western Tibetan stockades outside, and twenty-one Southern Fan stockades outside.
translations.idiomatic: Inside Xunhua's pass were twelve acculturated Fan tribes; outside were forty-nine Western Tibetan stockades and twenty-one Southern Fan stockades.

sentences.zh: 西藏管轄三十九族：納書克貢巴族，畢魯族，琫盆族，達格魯族，拉克族，色爾札族，札嘛爾族，阿札克族，上阿札克族，下阿札克族，夥爾川木桑族，夥爾札麻蘇他爾族，夥爾札麻蘇他爾，只多族，瓦拉族，夥爾族，麻魯族，寧塔，尼札爾，參麻布瑪，尼牙木札族，利松麻巴族，勒達克族，多麻巴族，羊巴族，依戎夥爾族，夥爾族，彭他麻族，夥爾拉賽族，上剛噶魯族，下剛噶魯族，瓊布拉克魯族，噶魯族，色爾札族，上多爾樹族，下多爾樹族，三札族，三納拉巴族，朴族。

sentences.zh: 以上四十族，共八千四百四十三戶。

translations.literal: The above forty tribes totaled eight thousand four hundred forty-three households.
translations.idiomatic: These forty tribes together numbered eight thousand four hundred forty-three households.

sentences.zh: 三十九族，共四千八百八十九戶。

translations.literal: The thirty-nine tribes totaled four thousand eight hundred eighty-nine households.
translations.idiomatic: The thirty-nine tribes together numbered four thousand eight hundred eighty-nine households.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，定族內人戶千戶以上設千戶一，百戶以上設百戶一，不及百戶者設百長一，每千、百戶下設散百長數人。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng reign, it was established that within each tribe, for households of one thousand or more a thousand-household officer was appointed; for one hundred or more, a centurion; for fewer than one hundred, a company chief; and under each thousand-household and centurion officer, several subordinate company chiefs were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongzheng, a tribal rank system was fixed: tribes of one thousand households or more received a thousand-household officer; those of one hundred or more, a centurion; those below one hundred, a company chief; and each thousand-household and centurion officer had several subordinate company chiefs beneath him.

sentences.zh: 至乾隆末，別定三十九族總百戶一，百戶十三，百長五十三，後增為百戶十六，百長六十一。

translations.literal: By the end of Qianlong, a separate appointment was made for the thirty-nine tribes in all: one chief centurion, thirteen centurions, and fifty-three company chiefs; later increased to sixteen centurions and sixty-one company chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: By the late Qianlong reign, the thirty-nine tribes were separately organized under one overall centurion, thirteen centurions, and fifty-three company chiefs — later raised to sixteen centurions and sixty-one company chiefs.
